content.title: Why AECOM (ACM) Stock Is Down Today
content.summary: Shares of infrastructure consulting service company AECOM (NYSE:ACM) fell 2.5% in the morning session after the company reported mixed earnings. AECOM narrowly topped analysts’ EBITDA expectations. On the other hand, its revenue missed and its full-year EBITDA guidance fell slightly short of Wall Street’s estimates. Overall, this was a weaker quarter.

content.title: AECOM (NYSE:ACM) Misses Q3 CY2025 Sales Expectations
content.summary: Infrastructure consulting service company AECOM (NYSE:ACM) fell short of the markets revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025 as sales only rose 1.6% year on year to $4.18 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.36 per share was 1.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
